title: Worksheet 5: The Prototype Pattern
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: The Prototype pattern creates new objects by copying an existing object, called the prototype, instead of building each new one from scratch. This is helpful when setting up an object takes a lot of work. For example, imagine a game where a Soldier takes 5 steps to set up: loading a picture, choosing a weapon, setting health to 100, setting speed, and adding a sound. If the game needs 50 soldiers, repeating all 5 steps 50 times would be slow and repetitive. With the Prototype pattern, the programmer sets up one soldier carefully, then makes 49 copies of it, called clones. If one clone needs a different weapon, the programmer changes only that clone's weapon after copying, and the other 48 clones are not affected. A common mistake is forgetting that a clone must be a truly separate copy; if clones secretly share parts with the original, changing one could change them all.
